message: After parting ways with Asahi, I came to the stadium by myself.

name: Iori
message: 「...‘Don’t carry the burden,’ huh.」
I know full well what Asahi wanted to say to me. She’s always been very perceptive.

name: Iori
message: 「Seeing it again like this brings back memories...」
And looking at this stadium brings it all back. What I should be carrying, not her.
Something I must never forget, something I can never forget—the memories of that summer.
—That year, too, it was a hot summer.
In the Murakumo Martial Festival, I managed to fight my way through the main tournament and made it to the finals.
I was a second-year in the Martial Arts Division, and I was determined to become the Toujinegi this year.

name: Iori
message: 「Man... the semifinals were rough.」
My opponent in the semis was a third-year, and since it was his last Martial Festival, his offensive was fierce and desperate.
In that sense, the upcoming final against someone I know well doesn’t carry that same kind of tension.

name: Iori
message: 「...Well, I always knew we’d face each other eventually. He’s more than worthy.」
I center my mind and regulate my breathing. My spirits rise naturally.

name: Iori
message: 「Because my opponent is the current Toujinegi.」
Last year, Takahisa took down several veterans to become the Toujinegi, a real rising star despite being only a first-year.
He’s already received offers from several professional Jindou teams and is the most talked-about athlete this year.

name: Iori
message: （Whoever wins becomes the Toujinegi. This match decides everything between me and Takahisa...！）

name: Iori
message: 「I’m going to win this year. I will not lose to Takahisa...！！」
Just as I was burning with that fighting spirit—

name: Takahisa
message: 「Yo, Iori! It’s finally time for our match, man! Ooh~, I’m getting pumped up!♪」

name: Iori
message: 「...Seriously? Are you an idiot for coming to your opponent’s waiting room at a time like this? What are you even thinking?」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Come on, what’s the point of glaring at each other now？」

name: Iori
message: 「Should I tell Asahi-chan about this later?」

name: Takahisa
message: 「W-wait, is she actually here!？ Iori, that’s dirty! You know I can’t stand up to Asahi, using her as a hostage like that!」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m kidding. I just saw her in the stands earlier.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Whoa, you got me there！ Hahaha, Iori’s got the upper hand now, huh.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you’re going to let your Iai and sword-drawing skills get rusty over something like this, maybe I really should take you hostage.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Oh ho, sure thing？ If you take her as your bride while you're at it, I'd feel at ease too! Wahahaha!」
We laugh loudly together in the waiting room before the match.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Listen up, Iori！ Come at me with everything you've got; I'm gonna go all out too！ Don't you dare end this while still holding your cards back！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course. I'm looking forward to it, Takahisa.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Oh yeah！ In that case, I'll be waiting for you！」
Saying that, Takahisa returned to his own waiting area.

name: Iori
message: 「Phew... haaah...」
The match became a tense, down-to-the-wire affair.
An offensive style that utilized innate reaction speed and Iai-style quick-draws to boldly attack and toy with the opponent despite the disadvantageous circumstances—.

name: Iori
message: （Guh, I can't push him back... At this rate, I'm done for！）

name: Takahisa
message: 「Come on, come on, don't you go losing your breath now...！ You're not the type to get taken down by something like this, are you！？」
His expression was brimming with intensity, as if he were a completely different person from the one I had shared a laugh with earlier.
I was gradually being driven into a corner.

name: Takahisa
message: 「How's that, look at it—this is the strike of a Toujinegi！！！」
Letting them cut your flesh to cut their bones, and vice versa. I couldn't land a single blow unless I whittled down his Barrier Jacket.

name: Iori
message: （No good... my stamina... it's all gone...！！）
I thought I had trained more than the average person, but it seemed I was no match for Takahisa.
Right now, Takahisa was about to settle this endless war of attrition.

name: Iori
message: （Am I... going to lose here？ Will the title of Toujinegi remain out of my reach this year too...？）
My breathing couldn't keep up with the physical exertion at all. My field of vision began to narrow, little by little.

name: Iori
message: （No... I absolutely refuse to lose...！！）
An emotion chilling me to the core—the beast had awakened.

name: Iori
message: 「Haa, haa... hah, haaah...！！」
That's right, didn't Takahisa say so himself?
Like this, with my cards still hidden. I cannot afford to end it here—

name: Iori
message: 「...The Muragaki essence, Tengen Saimei―ryuu―I come.」
I muttered the words as if sliding into another state.
Something flashed.
By the time I realized it.
Everything before my eyes was simply red... yes, dyed in deep crimson.

name: Iori
message: （I see, I was struck... I lost, didn't I...）
No, something is wrong. Is this... blood？
Screams filled the arena, and Takahisa writhed in agony.
Looking closely, my Origami had,
pierced clean through Takahisa's shoulder.

name: Iori
message: 「Taka, hisa...？」
With his artery severed, blood sprayed from Takahisa with every pulse.

name: Iori
message: <s34>"Ah... aaah, aaaaaaaah...！！！！"</s>
The match ended in my victory.
...Due to massive blood loss, Takahisa fell into a critical, unconscious state.
A few days later, he somehow managed to regain consciousness, but that wasn't the end of it.
Takahisa's right upper arm was on the verge of amputation.
Fortunately, the surgery was successful and he didn't lose his arm, but he could no longer move it as he once had.
...The impairment of his dominant arm was fatal for a swordsman.
The god-speed Iai draw that Takahisa showed when he was a Toujinegi was lost to the world forever.
Even so... Takahisa didn't give up.
At first, he had no grip strength and couldn't even hold a sword. He practiced swinging with his left hand instead.
After grueling, blood-sweating rehabilitation, Takahisa attempted the Martial Festival qualifiers in his third year.
But—the result was a loss in the qualifiers.
All offers from professional teams were canceled, and that was the end of Takahisa's Jindou.
I have no right to be involved in Jindou. Because there is no mistaking that it was I who stole Takahisa's dream.
Yes, that's why I abandoned my dream of becoming a teacher and knocked on the doors of the Ground Self-Defense Force.
I thought that was the just reward, and the just atonement.

name: Iori
message: 「And yet, what am I doing...」
Actually working as a teacher, I realized something.
I love this job of nurturing, teaching, and guiding others. I can't get enough of watching them grow, of seeing their happy faces.
Next year, and the year after that. If I could keep doing this job, how happy I would be.
And that is precisely why I must not be a teacher.
To have stolen Takahisa's dream and his happiness, only to find my own？ Such a thing can never be forgiven.

name: Iori
message: 「...Well, it's only until this mission is over」
Once this 'errand' is finished, I will return to the Tenju Special Forces.
That was both lonely, and a relief.
